description.en: The ID of the GTM instance.

description.zh: 是否需要额外信息，默认为**false**。取值为**true**时，返回AccessStrategyNum（访问策略个数）、AddressPoolNum（地址池个数）。
description.en: Specifies whether to return additional information. The default value is **false**. If you set this parameter to **true**, the response includes AccessStrategyNum (the number of access policies) and AddressPoolNum (the number of address pools).

example.unifiedCli: aliyun alidns describe-gtm-instance --lang en --instance-id instance1 --need-detail-attributes false --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun alidns DescribeGtmInstance --region cn-hangzhou --NeedDetailAttributes false --InstanceId instance1 --Lang en
